text:
maya: FYI onboarding ticket from Ryan @ Acme — their integration started failing this morning with 401/403 "insufficient_scopes" when hitting /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. they say the same API key used to work.
ryan (Acme): yep, started ~08:10 UTC. some calls succeed (embeddings) but generation calls are blocked. error: {"error":"insufficient_scopes", "required": ["generation"]} :confused:
maya: got the raw error in the support ticket, grabbing logs now. request id from customer for failing call: req_8f7a2bcd. they pasted the curl they run.
ryan (Acme): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XXXXX" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"gpt-xl","input":"hi"}'
  Response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scopes","message":"token missing generation scope"}
maya: quick repro locally using their key (sanitized) — I can reproduce 403 for generate, embeddings returns 200. so token only has embeddings scope.
alex: can you dump the token scopes from the console? I've seen provisioning bugs around SSO-provisioned keys recently.
maya: checking internal audit logs... @audit-bot can you paste the token creation event for sk-acme-XXXXX ?
audit-bot: Token created by user: ryan@acme.com via SSO provisioning (idp: acme-okta). Scopes granted: ["embeddings", "rerank"]. Note: generation not included. (event id evt_2026_03_15_0810)
maya: that explains the symptom. customer says they selected "all inference" during onboarding though. they were migrated from a trial org — maybe a UI bug.
ryan (Acme): we definitely clicked the full permissions toggle during setup. we need generation for app features.
lina: pinging eng infra. Alex, any known issues where SSO token provisioning drops generation scope?
alex: Not widespread, but we had one fix last quarter related to the checkbox not persisting for orgs migrated from legacy. I will triage. can you include repro steps + exact org id?
maya: repro steps I used: 1) Use customer's key sk-acme-XXXXX 2) POST /v1/generate -> 403 insufficient_scopes 3) GET /v1/keys/sk-acme-XXXXX returns scopes: ["embeddings","rerank"] 4) Console shows UI toggle was set to "All inference" (screenshot attached in ticket).
maya: attaching server logs snippet: ```2026-03-15T08:09:58Z [req_8f7a2bcd] auth: token sk-acme-XXXXX scopes=[embeddings rerank] check=generation -> denied```
alex: thanks. @lina can you escalate to identity team? suspect race/migration bug where legacy orgs got limited scopes when provisioning via SSO. I'll put together a hotfix if we can confirm root cause.
lina: raising incident marker in #incidents and assigning to idp-onboard. tagging @idp-team.
ryan (Acme): timeline please? this blocks a customer-facing feature in production, our deployment is stalled.
maya: temporary workaround — create a new API key in Console (non-SSO service key) or re-create the key with explicit scopes via Settings -> API keys. customer tried creating a new key and that worked (new key has generation scope). but they prefer SSO-managed keys for rotation.
alex: short-term mitigation: we can grant generation scope server-side for the affected key while idp team fixes provisioning. need approval from security ops (lina).
lina: security OK for targeted fix if we rotate keys and audit. please follow change window checklist.
maya: I'll propose the server-side grant and rotation plan to Acme and offer to rotate keys once fixed.
alex: dev action items: 1) run a query for tokens created via SSO in last 90 days where scopes do not include generation but UI indicates All Inference; 2) reproduce the UI->API mismatch in staging; 3) patch provisioning flow to persist generation scope. I'll create a JIRA and ping idp team.
maya: JIRA created: INF-4521 (SSO token provisioning drops generation scope on migrated orgs). linking ticket in support case.
ryan (Acme): appreciated — thanks Maya and Alex. pls keep me posted. our engineers are on standby for key rotation. :thumbsup:
maya: will update support ticket with timeline and the temporary server-side grant option. closing the loop with ops on rotation schedule.
support-bot: Case update: INF-4521 linked, escalation to idp-team, temporary server-side grant queued (change idchg_831).
maya: marking thread resolved for customer outreach, keeping open for eng follow-up.
alex: follow-up note for eng: check OAuth provisioning lambda logs around user->token mapping; I suspect a boolean flag lost when migrating legacy orgs.
lina: ops will schedule rotation and audit after fix. ETA initial triage 2h.
ryan (Acme): thanks everyone. we'll test after fix and rotate keys.
maya: I'll update when change is complete. :white_check_mark:
